system.roleplaying: You have a state of blissful ignorance. Grudges, entanglements, and commitments slide right off you.
system.minorTwist: What slid off you previously that could have been useful right now?
system.majorTwist: What major thing did you forget and why did forgetting it make your situation much worse?

greenAbility.name: Principle of the Spotless Mind
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome a situation where being free of the past is useful and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
